# Discover Lithuania

> A curated travel guide to Lithuania — 152+ handpicked cafés, restaurants, stays, nature spots and ready-made routes across 12 regions. Available in English and Hebrew.

## About the site

Discover Lithuania is an independent travel guide built by Niv Shimoni — entrepreneur, AI builder, and someone who keeps ending up in Lithuania. Every place on the site has been personally reviewed or vetted. Not sponsored. Not algorithmic. Just what's actually worth visiting.

The site covers 152+ places across 10 regions: Vilnius, Trakai, Kaunas, Klaipėda, the Curonian Spit (Nida), Druskininkai, Palanga, Molėtai, Zarasai, and the Lithuanian countryside.

## What you'll find

- **Places**: cafés, restaurants, nature spots, stays, cultural sites — each with a personal note from Niv on why it's worth visiting
- **Routes**: ready-made itineraries for every trip length — from a single day to a full weekend
- **Food guide**: traditional Lithuanian dishes explained (cepelinai, šaltibarščiai, kibinai, and more)
- **Stays**: handpicked accommodation from boutique spas to forest cabins and lake villas

## Ready-made itineraries

- **A Perfect Day in Vilnius** — Baroque alleys, Užupis art republic, MO Museum, rooftop drinks
- **Vilnius & The Region** (weekend) — Vilnius day + Trakai castle, Snapas café, hot air balloon over the lakes
- **A Weekend in the Forests** — forest cabins, lakes, traditional sauna (pirtis)
- **Three Days on the Coast** — Klaipėda old town, Curonian Spit dunes, Nida lagoon, Stebuklai SPA
- **Druskininkai Spa Weekend** — mineral springs, float therapy, pine forest walks

## Highlights

- Vilnius Old Town (UNESCO) — cobblestones, Baroque churches, best coffee scene in the Baltics
- Curonian Spit — UNESCO dunes, pine forests, and the idyllic village of Nida
- Trakai Castle — 14th-century island fortress on Lake Galvė, Karaim culture, kibinai pastries
- Druskininkai — mineral springs, spa retreats, Grūtas Soviet sculpture park
- Klaipėda — German-Prussian old town and Baltic port city
- Aukštaitija National Park — 3,000+ lakes, forest trails, canoe routes
- Snapas café, Trakai — cozy lakeside spot for coffee and pastry before the castle

## Practical info

- **Currency**: Euro (€) — Lithuania is affordable. Coffee ~€3, full meal €8–15.
- **Language**: Lithuanian. English widely spoken in cities.
- **Best time to visit**: May–September. June–August is peak season with festivals and long days.
- **Getting there**: Vilnius Airport (VNO) has direct flights from Tel Aviv, London, Berlin, Warsaw, Riga.
- **Safety**: One of the safest countries in Europe. Low crime, especially in tourist areas.

## Who this is for

Travelers who want real recommendations — not TripAdvisor averages or Wikipedia entries. Particularly useful for Israeli travelers (site is bilingual Hebrew/English), first-time Lithuania visitors, and anyone planning a 3–7 day trip.
